metrics.chance: the members' share of the candidate genes
metrics.definition: Share of the returned genes that are hidden members.
metrics.label: Precision
metrics.reading: How many of the candidates are real.

metrics.chance: the returned share of the candidate genes
metrics.definition: Share of the hidden members that were returned.
metrics.label: Recall
metrics.reading: How much of the set was found.

metrics.chance: low; about the members' share for a random return of the same size
metrics.definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
metrics.label: F1
metrics.reading: One number that is only high when both are.

metrics.definition: Overlap of returned and hidden sets divided by their union.
metrics.label: Jaccard index
metrics.reading: How close the returned set is to being exactly the hidden set; stricter than F1.

metrics.definition: Correlation between 'returned' and 'is a hidden member' over all candidate genes.
metrics.label: Matthews correlation (MCC)
metrics.reading: Accounts for the genes correctly NOT returned as well; honest when the set is small.

metrics.definition: Precision divided by the members' share of the candidate genes.
metrics.label: Fold enrichment
metrics.reading: How many times more members the returned set holds than a random set of its size.

metrics.definition: How many genes the strategy returned as the set.
metrics.label: Genes returned
metrics.reading: Context: a high recall from returning half the genome is not a finding.
